singbox.why: Remnawave's sing-box generator (singbox.generator.service.ts) writes no uTLS for a host without a fingerprint: SFA says Go's hello. Xray takes Chrome's when none is named (tls.GetFingerprint), and so does the decoder for the link and the Xray JSON.
